posts.topic: AI Climbs to Number Two CFO Priority
posts.hook: AI jumped from fourth to second place on the CFO priority list for 2026.
posts.key_stat: AI and automation now rank as the number two CFO priority for 2026, up from fourth a year earlier.
posts.visual_direction: Clean stat card foregrounding the number two ranking with a small fourth-to-second movement indicator, formal enterprise palette, generous white space.
